facts.fact: The National Digital Development Strategy of December 2022 says connections to public buildings, local councils among them, are to be prioritised, and its implementation plan sets as a long-term action for 2027 to extend broadband access to all government institutions nationwide, including local councils, schools, hospitals and libraries; it gives no count of councils, no baseline and, in the passages held, no cost.
facts.system: Broadband access for government institutions including local councils

facts.fact: The strategy of December 2022 names the Ministry of Information and Communications as lead for extending broadband to all government institutions including local councils by 2027, with DSTI, the universal access fund UADF, NDiDA, NaTCA, Leonecom, Zoodlabs and internet service providers as partners.
facts.system: Broadband access for government institutions including local councils
